meta.title: Pixel parity
meta.description: Aligns a repository's frontend with a design image, reference page, or prototype: detects the dev server and routes, compares geometry, computed styles, and masked pixels per case and viewport, and keeps approved baselines for regression. Adds parity_init, parity_run, parity_approve, and parity_check plus a workflow skill. Requires a local Chromium or Playwright; artifacts go to .parity/.
